faq.q: What did townhomes in Lower Landing sell for?
faq.a: 6 townhomes sold in Lower Landing between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $613,950.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Lower Landing?
faq.a: The median was 97 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 99.1% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What did houses in Lower Landing sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Lower Landing between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,015,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lower Landing?
faq.a: The median was 48 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How much do Lower Landing homes cost compared with the rest of Chilliwack?
faq.a: The median Lower Landing townhome sold for $613,950 against $572,500 across Chilliwack, and the median house for $1,015,000 against $825,000. Lower Landing figures rest on 6 townhome and 5 house sales, Chilliwack figures on 108 and 294, for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How new are the homes in Lower Landing?
faq.a: The median year built was 2025 for townhomes and 2025 for houses, so most sales were of homes finished in the past two years. The typical townhome had 3 bedrooms and the typical house 5.

faq.q: What is the strata fee for a Lower Landing townhome?
faq.a: All 6 townhome sales reported a monthly fee and the median was $70. Ask for the strata documents on any complex, since a low fee in a new complex can rise once the reserve fund is set by the owners.

faq.q: Are there new homes still being sold in Lower Landing?
faq.a: Yes, the new-construction page for Lower Landing lists the active new and newly built homes from the MLS® system, and it updates as listings change. Builders may also sell homes that are not on the MLS® system, so ask Jared if you want a project checked.
